name: Fly.io
long_description: We run app servers and databases close to end users. Developers deploy their apps to Fly.io (it's about the simplest place to deploy a Docker Image) and use our CLI to launch instances in regions that are most important for their application.
one_liner: Run full stack apps close to your users.

app_answers.question: Describe what your company does in 50 characters or less.
What is your company going to make? Please describe your product and what it does or will do.
app_answers.answer: We're building a global hosting service. Devs package up their project, ship it with our CLI, and then we scale it up and down in whichever cities they have users in.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Hi, I’m Michael. I’m a software designer and engineer living in Colorado.

I build things that I find useful, which often leads me to toward developer tools. I care a lot about delightful user experiences. I also care a lot about building healthy engineering teams that invest in the next generation of engineers.
